defs.def: unhappy or showing unhappiness 悲哀的；难过的；显得悲哀的

ex.s: “That’s so sad,” he said, “but you still know all those words, even without the book.” I realized that this was true.
ex.t: “那太遗憾了，”他说，“不过即使没有那本书，你依然认识那些词。”我意识到这话确实没错。

ex.s: If I ever get trapped outside my house again, my local telephone box will, sadly, no longer be able to connect me with my keys.
ex.t: 如果我再次被困在屋外，我当地的电话亭将悲哀地不能再帮我拿到钥匙了。

ex.s: During one morning ride, Cruse noticed a kindergartner seemed a little sad.
All kinds of human emotions are on display: sad (tearful goodbyes), happy (family get-togethers), anxious (waiting in a long line) and upset (missing a flight).
ex.t: 各种人类情感在这里展现：悲伤（含泪告别）、快乐（家庭团聚）、焦虑（排长队等候）和沮丧（错过航班）。
我每天都在动物园亲手照顾它们，我也很怀念我们一起度过的时光。

ex.s: Her owners were sad too, but they knew their son would be back to visit.
He would    45    the loudest over fun and be the saddest over anyone’s   46    .
ex.t: 遇到有趣的事他会____最大声，遇到任何人的____他会最伤心。

ex.s: As sad as it was, I couldn’t help smiling.
ex.t: 尽管这件事令人悲伤，我还是忍不住微笑了。

ex.s: They are sad to part with the old theater.
ex.t: 他们为与老剧院分别而感到难过。

ex.s: As sad as it was, I couldn’t help smiling .
ex.t: 史蒂夫·乔布斯去世仅五年后，智能手机就在销量上击败了________电脑。

ex.s: This made Hannah very sad, and even more   41   to do something.
ex.t: "汉娜之地"分为几个区域，在天冷到____户外意味着死亡的时候为人们提供庇护。

ex.s: Her mother told her that if she did something to change the problem that made her sad, she wouldn’t   43    as bad.
ex.t: 例如，她在2007年获得了BRICK奖，该奖项认可年轻人改变世界的____。

defs.def: that makes you feel unhappy 令人悲哀的；让人难过的

ex.s: At first I was really sad, but later I realized that I joined the team for the love of the sport.
ex.t: 一开始我真的很伤心，但后来我意识到我加入球队是因为对这项运动的热爱。

ex.s: I showed her the eggs and sadly explained what happened.
ex.t: 我给她看了那些蛋，难过地解释了发生的事情。

ex.s: Sadly, human activity is the main reason why the number of monarch butterflies is falling.
ex.t: 可悲的是，人类活动是黑脉金斑蝶数量下降的主要原因。

ex.s: Eventually, realising / realised that every emotion has a role, Joy understands it is okay for Riley to feel sad sometimes.
ex.t: 最终，意识到每种情绪都有其作用，Joy明白Riley有时感到悲伤也是可以的。

ex.s: "Sadly, Mallory would die on the mountain in 1924, although his body would not be found until many years later.
ex.t: "可悲的是，马洛里于1924年在山上遇难，尽管他的遗体直到多年后才被找到。

defs.def: unacceptable; deserving blame or criticism 让人无法接受的；该受责备（或批评）的
boring or not fashionable 乏味的；过时的
in poor condition 状况不佳的
